feature.name: Table Design
feature.what_it_does: Style a selected table — apply a table style, toggle which parts the style emphasizes, and set shading and borders.
feature.affects: the visual style of the selected table
feature.behavior: Style a selected table — apply a table style, toggle which parts the style emphasizes, and set shading and borders. Group controls: subfeature:table-borders, subfeature:table-shading, subfeature:table-style-options, subfeature:table-styles

connections.why: measured: the hosting contextual tab appears only in this object's context

subfeatures.name: Table Borders
subfeatures.what_it_does: Sets the table's borders — border style/pen weight/pen color (options), which edges get a border, the border painter, and the Borders and Shading dialog.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens the Border Styles (dropdown) dropdown — the surface that presents this capability's options (23 controls enumerated in the structural pass). Applying a choice there changes: the selected cells' borders.

behavior_record.effect: Opens the Border Styles (dropdown) dropdown — the surface that presents this capability's options (23 controls enumerated in the structural pass). Applying a choice there changes: the selected cells' borders.

subfeatures.name: Table Shading
subfeatures.what_it_does: Fills the selected cells' background with a color from the shading picker.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens the Shading (dropdown) dropdown — the surface that presents this capability's options (5 controls enumerated in the structural pass). Applying a choice there changes: the selected cells' background fill.
